localization.promotionalText: Create persistent AI bots that remember approved context, collaborate on work, and run with private on-device intelligence on your Mac.
localization.description:
Codelit gives you a small team of persistent AI bots that lives on your Mac. Create a bot in plain language, talk through the work, and keep each conversation, run, memory, and skill together in one focused workspace.

Start without an account. Codelit can use its built-in on-device model on supported Macs, so local prompts and model output stay on the device. You can also select a user-owned API provider when you explicitly choose it. Codelit never silently changes billing families.

Each bot has a clear job, approved memory, reusable skills, a local data table, and an inspectable history. Add specialist bots to a conversation when a task benefits from another perspective. Runs show a clear status while private safety records preserve approvals and failures without cluttering the conversation.

The Mac App Store version supports local conversations, bots, memories, skills, multi-bot handoffs, selected-folder reads, and private local run history. It does not request Accessibility or Screen Recording access, and it does not include background routines, automated website inspection, or computer control.

localization.releaseNotes: A calmer, more readable bot workspace with clearer task-first bot creation, improved starter actions, and refined light, dark, and compact layouts.

commerce.copy: The App Store build is free and works without a Codelit account. It does not show prices, checkout links, or purchase prompts.

dataTypes.condition: Only when the user explicitly selects a user-owned API provider for a bot run. Built-in on-device model runs remain local.

privacy.localOnlyData: Bot conversations, prompts, memories, skills, routines, local tables, run events, receipts, permissions, and model data remain on the Mac when the built-in model is selected.

ageRating.reason: The App Store build does not expose a browser or automated website inspection.

exportCompliance.implementation: AES-256-GCM protects local workspace records and standard HTTPS protects explicitly selected user-owned API provider traffic.
exportCompliance.determination: App Store Connect classified the standard encryption as exempt without document upload when France is excluded.
exportCompliance.releaseRule: Keep France unavailable unless a required French encryption declaration is cleared.
